         5       DeFrancisco.

         6                  SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:    Yes, I just

         7       want to explain my vote.  I'm sponsoring this

         8       legislation, and I of course vote yes.

         9                  I just want to explain how this

        10       legislation arose and my thoughts behind

        11       sponsoring legislation which would increase

        12       the penalties for leaving the scene of a

        13       boating accident, and the most serious penalty

        14       would be in the event that the accident ended

        15       in serious injury or death.  That offense

        16       would be a D felony now.

        17                  This arose as a result of two

        18       horrific accidents or incidents -- not really

        19       accidents, they were reckless conduct on

        20       behalf of the individuals.  One was on

        21       Skaneateles Lake, where a young man by the

        22       name of John Kelly and a young woman by the

        23       name of Heather Wilkins were struck by another

        24       boater, and the boater and his friends left

        25       the scene of the accident.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         1132



         1                  By the time people learned of the

         2       incident, found the boat, both of the

         3       individuals were dead.  Which possibly could

         4       have been avoided had people gone and reported

         5       the accident when it should have been

         6       reported.  That was on Skaneateles Lake.

         7                  Also, on Oneida Lake, also in

         8       Onondaga County, an older gentleman was

         9       minding his own business fishing, and a very

        10       violent collision occurred.  The other boat

        11       was operated by another young person with

        12       other young people in the boat with him.  He

        13       struck that vehicle in such a violent way

        14       that -- and left the scene, just left.

        15                  And later, when the man was finally

        16       found, he was found dead as well.  There was a

        17       very good chance that that individual could

        18       have been saved in the event that someone had

        19       at least told about the accident.

        20                  So this is a serious business.  And

        21       we've increased the penalties over the years

        22       for incidents like this dealing with motor

        23       vehicles.  And this bill really catches up to

        24       the same situation, which is just as serious

        25       in boating accidents.
